ITEM.PTXT: A full-fabric air element, whose filter material uses no outer frame or rubber seal, has been adopted with consideration for recyclability, and the case is a removable cap type for excellent serviceability.
A resonator is provided on the air cleaner hose to reduce high-frequency intake noise.
A hot-wire type plug-in air flow meter with a built-in intake air temperature sensor has been adopted, reducing size and weight.
